name: CCA 985 电子舱问题 电子舱冒烟

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 985, from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are at bay 221, with information H, contact Wuhan Delivery for Airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 985，从 Wuhan 到 Frankfurt，位于 221 号停机位，收到信息 H，联系武汉放行请求航路许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 985, bay 221, information H, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 985，221 号停机位，信息 H，请求前往 Frankfurt 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, Runway 04, follow ZF-01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters on QNH, cruising level 9500 meters, departure frequency 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Frankfurt，跑道 04，执行 ZF-01 离场，按 QNH 初始爬升到 1500 米，巡航高度 9500 米，离场频率 119.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, Runway 04,  follow ZF-01 departure, initially climb to 1500 meters on QNH, cruising level 9500 meters, departure frequency 119.35, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Frankfurt，跑道 04，执行 ZF-01 离场，按 QNH 初始爬升到 1500 米，巡航高度 9500 米，离场频率 119.35，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, read back correct, your slot time is 1435, contact Wuhan Ground 121.85.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，复诵正确，你的放行时刻是 1435，联系武汉地面121.85。

cards.audioText: B: During push back, you have a small avionics problem, you wish to remain on taxiway Z4 for approximately 5 minutes, inform Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 推出期间，你有一个小的航电问题，希望在滑行道 Z4 上停留约 5 分钟，通知 武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 985, request remain on taxiway Z4 due small avionics problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 985，因小的航电问题，请求停留在滑行道 Z4。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CCA 985, advise when you are ready.
B: You decide the maintenance are needed before departure, tell Wuhan Ground you want to return to gate 221 to have plane checked by engineers.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，CCA 985，准备好时通知。
B: 你决定起飞前需要维修，告诉 武汉地面 你想返回 221 号登机口，让工程师检查飞机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 985, request taxi back to gate 221 to have plane checked by engineers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 985，请求滑回 221 号登机口，让工程师检查飞机。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, gate 221 will be occupied by another aircraft in a minute, stand by for a while, I will assign you another gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，221 号登机口一分钟后将被另一架飞机占用，稍等，我会给你分配另一个登机口。

cards.audioText: B: The engineers have fixed the avionics problem, request Wuhan Ground for engine start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 工程师已修复航电问题，向武汉地面请求发动机开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 985, the engineers have fixed the avionics problem, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 985，工程师已修复航电问题，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, your slot time is expired, your new slot time is 1615, start up at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，你的放行时刻已过期，新放行时刻是 1615，自行决定开车。
cards.referenceText: Slot time 1615, start up at own discretion, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行时刻 1615，自行决定开车，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the engine start up procedures, call Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成发动机开车程序，呼叫 武汉地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 985, start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 985，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, taxi via taxiway C, M and A to holding point Runway 04, hold short of Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，经滑行道 C、M 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Z4 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway C, M and A to holding point Runway 04, hold short of Z4, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 C、M 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Z4 前等待，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: B: You are now at holding point Runway 04, you are ready for takeoff, call Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 04 等待点，准备起飞，呼叫 武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, holding point Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 985，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, surface wind 070 degrees, 3 meters per second, cleared for takeoff, Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，地面风 070 度，3 米/秒，跑道 04 可以起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Shortly after airborne, smoke is coming from the avionics bay, make a Distress call to Wuhan Tower and ask for immediate return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 离地后不久，航电舱冒烟，向武汉塔台发出遇险呼叫并请求立即返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, smoke is coming from the avionics bay, request immediate return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，CCA 985，航电舱冒烟，请求立即返回着陆。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Tower you want to level off at 600 meters and remain on the tower frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 武汉塔台 你想在 600 米改平，并保持在塔台频率。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, request level off at 600 meters and remain this frequency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 985，请求在 600 米改平并保持本频率。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Tower you want to fly a right-hand circuit for immediate landing Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 武汉塔台 你想加入右起落航线，立即在跑道 04 着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, request join right-hand circuit for immediate landing Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 985，请求加入右起落航线，立即在跑道 04 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind Runway 04, report turning base.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，保持 600 米，右转加入跑道 04 下风，转基线时报告。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind Runway 04, report turning base, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 600 米，右转加入跑道 04 下风，转基线时报告，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: B: The smoke situation cannot be controlled, request emergency services upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 烟雾情况无法控制，请求着陆时提供应急服务。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, smoke cannot be controlled, request emergency services upon landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 985，烟雾无法控制，请求着陆时提供应急服务。
